title: 千字文（节选）
author: 周兴嗣
intro: For over a thousand years Chinese children learned to read with this text: one thousand characters, none repeated, in rhyming four-character lines. Its opening describes how the universe began and how the seasons turn.
analysis: 《千字文》是中国古代最有名的识字课本之一，一千个字没有一个重复，四个字一句，押韵整齐，非常适合背诵。这里选的是开头十六句。最前面“天地玄黄，宇宙洪荒”，说天是深青色的，地是黄色的，宇宙刚开始时广大而混沌。接下来写太阳月亮的圆缺升落、星星的排列，一年四季冷热交替，秋天收获、冬天储藏，还讲到古人用闰月调整历法、用音律测定节气。然后写云变成雨、露凝成霜，再写各地的宝物：丽水出金子，昆仑山出美玉，最好的剑叫“巨阙”，最好的珠叫“夜光”，水果里李子和柰最珍贵，蔬菜里芥菜和姜最重要。短短六十四个字，从天到地，从时间到物产，就像一部小小的百科全书。其中不少句子今天还在用，比如成语“寒来暑往”。
analysisEn: The Thousand Character Classic was one of China’s most famous primers: exactly one thousand characters with not a single one repeated, arranged in rhyming four-character phrases that children could chant and memorise. This selection is its first sixteen phrases. It begins at the very beginning: “Heaven is dark, earth is yellow; the universe was vast and wild.” Then the sun and moon wax, wane and set, and the stars take their places. Cold comes and heat goes; autumn is for harvest, winter for storing. Ancient astronomy appears too — leap months that keep the calendar in line, and musical pitch-pipes used to track the seasons. Clouds rise and bring rain, dew gathers and turns to frost. Then the text moves down to earth and its treasures: gold from the Li River, jade from the Kunlun Mountains, the sword called Juque, the pearl called Night Shine, the plum and crab apple as the best fruits, mustard greens and ginger as the most valued vegetables. In sixty-four characters it travels from the sky to the market garden — a tiny encyclopedia. For a learner it is also a word bank: many of these phrases, like 寒来暑往 (“cold comes, heat goes”), are still used today.
background: Zhou Xingsi (died 521) was an official under Emperor Wu of Liang. Tradition says the emperor gave him a thousand separate characters copied from the calligraphy of Wang Xizhi and asked him to turn them into a rhyming text — and that he finished in one night, his hair turning white from the effort.
pronunciation: 辰宿 chén xiù（星宿的“宿”读 xiù，不读 sù）；昃 zè；冬藏 cáng；律吕 lǜ lǚ；调阳 tiáo；露结为霜的“为”读 wéi；丽水 lì shuǐ（古地名，指今云南金沙江一带，传统读 lì；今浙江丽水市读 lí）；巨阙 jù què；称 chēng；李柰 nài；重 zhòng；芥 jiè。机器朗读“宿”“柰”容易读错，已在“朗读用字”列替换同音字，音频需人工听验。
version: 采用通行本。《千字文》全文二百五十句、一千字，这里节选开头十六句（从“天地玄黄”到“菜重芥姜”），每两句排成一行，共八行。

lines.py: tiān dì xuán huáng, yǔ zhòu hóng huāng
lines.lit: Heaven is dark, earth is yellow; the universe is vast and wild.
lines.en: The sky is deep and dark, the earth is yellow; the universe began vast and untamed.

lines.py: rì yuè yíng zè, chén xiù liè zhāng
lines.lit: The sun and moon grow full and slant; the stars and constellations are spread in rows.
lines.en: The moon waxes, the sun sinks west; the stars spread out in their places.

lines.py: hán lái shǔ wǎng, qiū shōu dōng cáng
lines.lit: Cold comes, heat goes; in autumn we harvest, in winter we store.
lines.en: Cold arrives and heat departs; autumn brings the harvest, winter keeps it safe.

lines.py: rùn yú chéng suì, lǜ lǚ tiáo yáng
lines.lit: Leftover days make a leap month to complete the year; pitch-pipes tune the yang of the seasons.
lines.en: Extra days add up to a leap month; the pitch-pipes keep the seasons in tune.

lines.py: yún téng zhì yǔ, lù jié wéi shuāng
lines.lit: Clouds rise and bring rain; dew gathers and becomes frost.
lines.en: Clouds rise and turn to rain; dew settles and turns to frost.

lines.py: jīn shēng lì shuǐ, yù chū kūn gāng
lines.lit: Gold is found in the Li River; jade comes from the Kunlun hills.
lines.en: Gold comes from the Li River, jade from the Kunlun Mountains.

lines.py: jiàn hào jù què, zhū chēng yè guāng
lines.lit: The sword is named Juque; the pearl is called Night Shine.
lines.en: The finest sword is Juque, the finest pearl is Night Shine.

lines.py: guǒ zhēn lǐ nài, cài zhòng jiè jiāng
lines.lit: Among fruits, the plum and crab apple are prized; among vegetables, mustard greens and ginger are valued.
lines.en: Plums and crab apples are the prize fruits; mustard greens and ginger, the prize vegetables.

words.note: 今天多是“玄妙”“玄学”（深奥）的意思。

words.en: vast and primeval; chaos at the beginning of the world
words.note: 今天还说“洪荒时代”“洪荒之力”。
现代汉语“充盈”“盈利”“月盈月亏”。

words.en: cold comes, heat goes; time passes
words.note: 今天仍是常用成语，形容岁月流逝。

words.en: the twelve pitch-pipes of ancient music

words.note: 今天“夜光”指在黑暗中发光，如“夜光表”。

imagery.name: 天地
imagery.zh: 开篇“天地玄黄”，从天和地写起，交代整个世界的开端。
imagery.en: The text opens with heaven and earth themselves — the starting point of the whole world.

imagery.name: 日月
imagery.zh: 日月的圆缺升落，代表时间运行有规律。
imagery.en: The sun and moon rising, setting, waxing and waning show that time runs in orderly cycles.

imagery.name: 霜
imagery.zh: “露结为霜”写自然的变化：露水遇冷就变成霜，季节在悄悄转换。
imagery.en: “Dew turns to frost” shows nature changing quietly as the cold season arrives.
